course_title: Generative and Agentic AI (Gen AI with LLMs), SMU, AY2026-27
note: Week numbers follow the topic numbers of the lecture decks. The dates are PLACEHOLDERS: replace each with the real seminar date, or with the date you give a mock recording. 'materials' are filename patterns matched against the files in MATERIALS_DIR.

discussion_prompts: Why does TF-IDF rank documents better than raw word counts?
What can Word2Vec capture that bag-of-words cannot, and what can it still not capture?

key_concepts: transformer block: FFN, residuals, layer norm
discussion_prompts: When would you still choose a BERT-style encoder over a decoder LLM?
How do you tell from the loss curves when fine-tuning starts to overfit?
When is RLVR a better fit than RLHF?
Your model gives outdated prices. Should you fine-tune? Why or why not?
Why does LoRA fit on one GPU when full fine-tuning does not?

key_concepts: greedy, top-k, top-p and beam search
discussion_prompts: What does temperature do to the next-token distribution?
Why is decoding memory-bound, and how does batching help?
Why are BLEU and ROUGE poor metrics for a chatbot?
How would you make an LLM judge trustworthy?

key_concepts: the agent loop and the harness
discussion_prompts: What makes a system agentic rather than one LLM call behind a UI?
What should the harness enforce, rather than the LLM?
When is long-context prompting a better choice than RAG?
When is agentic RAG worth its extra cost over a fixed pipeline?
